items.text: Detroit: LB Jack Campbell (neck) remained hospitalized after being immobilized on a backboard in Week 8. TBD: S Brian Branch and LB DJ Wonnum (concussions), CB D.J. Reed (hip), C Cade Mays (ankle), RB Jacob Saylors (neck, doubtful). On IR: S Kerby Joseph (PUP), RB Isiah Pacheco, LB Devin White, G Ben Bartch.
Miami (TBD): OT Kadyn Proctor (concussion). RB De'Von Achane (ACL) out for the season; CB Storm Duck on IR.
